mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change < -0.1%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is below -0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE rising > 0.5 percentage points in one month) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.5% in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO 3-month change < -0.5%) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-month change is below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts (HOUST falling > 10% year-over-year) signals a weakening real estate market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal a recessionary labor market under monetary easing, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized and UNRATE < 5.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to strong corporate earnings growth and sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 2.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%).
